name: LinkedIn Automation
tagline: Keeps a LinkedIn presence running: posts in your voice, prospects filed by topic
description: It keeps a LinkedIn presence moving on your behalf: drafting and publishing posts that read like your own writing, working through engagement in topic-scoped passes, and filing anyone who looks like a buyer into a spreadsheet that keeps one tab per topic. You review the sheet instead of chasing the feed.
author: melvindvivas
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
